response.sql: WITH obs_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) as share FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), avg_share_all AS (SELECT AVG(share) as average_share FROM obs_counts), filtered AS (SELECT telescope_count, share FROM obs_counts WHERE share > (SELECT average_share FROM avg_share_all)) SELECT AVG(telescope_count) as avg_telescope_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share) - (SELECT average_share FROM avg_share_all) as share_above_average FROM filtered
